articles.summary: Brookdale Senior Living, the nation’s largest operator of senior living communities has been named a “Best Pet Workplace” by WUF World, an organization dedicated to celebrating the human-animal bond.
articles.title: Brookdale Senior Living recognized as a "Best Pet Workplace"

articles.summary: Brookdale Senior Living, the nation’s largest operator of senior living communities and third largest owner of senior living real estate, proudly announces the recipients of its 2025 Cornerstone Awards, the company’s highest honor for associates.
articles.title: Brookdale Senior Living Announces 2025 Cornerstone Award Winners
